bio: Kempton’s at Sunningdale Park is set within 16.5 acres of beautiful gardens, lakes and natural woodland in the magnificent Grade II listed Northcote House.  Offering a traditional Afternoon Tea, that is comprised of a selection of seasonal sandwiches, homemade scones with jam and clotted cream, homemade cake and biscuits.  Gluten free, vegetarian and vegan options are available upon request.  Just a 5 minutes’ drive from Ascot, Kempton’s is nestled inside the luxury village of Sunningdale Park. Kempton’s blends stylish, contemporary decor with quintessential English charm.  On your visit your Afternoon Tea may be presented a little differently to the images displayed. The venue vary their selection of sweet treats according to seasonality and adapt their offering so that regular guests can look forward to something new each time. They also theme their Afternoon Tea from time to time, so your experience will feel a little more exclusive during events such as Valentine’s Day, Mother’s Day, Easter, Father’s Day, Halloween and Christmas.  A lighter Cream Tea option is available should you prefer, and  Vegan and Gluten-free dietary requirements can also be catered for. The venue politely ask that all Afternoon Tea bookings are placed in advance and that any special requests are made at the time of booking, to ensure they can provide the best possible experience on the day.
